title: Open Finance
subtitle: Your banks and cards, connected through Meu Pluggy.
description: Authorize your banks in Meu Pluggy and connect the MeuPluggy connector in the Pluggy Dashboard. Add each bank's itemId here. The service refreshes data every 24 hours; fetching here reads the latest available update.

setup.title: Server configuration pending
setup.description: Configure PLUGGY_CLIENT_ID and PLUGGY_CLIENT_SECRET on the server. Never paste these credentials into a screen field.

connect.title: Connect a bank
connect.description: Use the itemId created by the MeuPluggy connector, which provides free access to your own data. Up to five personal connections at the provider.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Add your authorized banks to list available accounts and cards.
connections.attention: This connection needs attention in Meu Pluggy.

mapping.title: Map an account or card
mapping.description: Choose the fi-sync destination and the import start date. Connecting does not change opening balances or generate future installments.

review.title: Transactions to review
review.description: Review before importing. Transfers between your accounts should be linked to existing transfer transactions. Card payments are not imported as refunds; register payments on the invoices screen.

existing.label: Existing transaction with the same date and amount

empty.title: No new transactions
empty.description: Previously imported or ignored transactions do not appear again. Available history depends on the bank.

selection.count: {count, plural, one {# transaction on this page} other {# transactions on this page}}

create.title: Review import
create.description: Check the transaction and, for card purchases, the invoice dates. Importing creates only this transaction. If it already exists, link it instead of creating another.

stale.title: Transaction updated
stale.description: The bank changed this transaction. Close the review, fetch the data again and check it before importing.

configuration.title: Incomplete configuration
configuration.description: Configure the Meu Pluggy credentials on the server.

provider.title: Could not query Meu Pluggy
provider.description: Check your connection and authorization in Meu Pluggy and try again.

access.title: Access unavailable
access.description: This integration is only available to the authorized user.

mapping.title: Invalid mapping
mapping.description: Choose an active account with the same currency and type, and an active card belonging to it.

duplicate.title: Possible duplicate
duplicate.description: A transaction with the same date and amount exists. Link it or ignore this record.

pending.title: Pending transaction
pending.description: Wait for confirmation from the bank before importing.

payment.title: Invoice payment
payment.description: Register the payment on the invoices screen or link an existing payment.

currency.title: Unsupported currency
currency.description: This initial integration only imports amounts in Brazilian reais, without currency conversion.

invoice.title: Check the invoice
invoice.description: Provide valid closing and due dates for the destination invoice.

busy.title: Import in progress
busy.description: Wait a moment and try again.
